description: Find a sports or trading card and its current sold price. Describe the card the way a collector would, for example "1989 Upper Deck Ken Griffey Jr 1", "2018 Topps Update Acuna US250" or "Charizard Base Set". Returns up to 5 matching cards with the raw (ungraded) and PSA 10 price, a card_id, and the link to the card page. Use get_card_prices for every grade of one card. Needs a HobbyCardIndex API key.

category.description: Optional: baseball, basketball, football, hockey, soccer, pokemon, magic, yugioh, one piece ...

query.description: Year, set, player or character, and card number if known.

name: search_cards
title: Search card prices
